instruction: Use compose with GPU count reservation
output: echo 'services: app: image: nvidia/cuda:12.4-runtime deploy: resources: reservations: devices: - driver: nvidia count: all capabilities: [gpu]' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: app: build: . develop: watch: - action: sync path: ./src target: /app/src' >> docker-compose.yml

instruction: Use compose watch with rebuild action
output: echo 'services: app: develop: watch: - action: rebuild path: ./package.json' >> docker-compose.yml

instruction: Use compose watch with sync and restart
output: echo 'services: app: develop: watch: - action: sync+restart path: ./config target: /app/config' >> docker-compose.yml
docker compose watch

instruction: Use compose with depends_on without waiting
output: echo 'services: web: depends_on: - db' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: depends_on: db: condition: service_healthy' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: app: depends_on: migration: condition: service_completed_successfully' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: batch: restart: no' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: restart: always' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: worker: restart: on-failure:5' >> docker-compose.yml

instruction: Use compose with deploy mode replicated
output: echo 'services: web: deploy: mode: replicated replicas: 3' >> docker-compose.yml

instruction: Use compose with deploy mode global
output: echo 'services: agent: deploy: mode: global' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: endpoint_mode: dnsrr' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: update_config: parallelism: 2 delay: 10s order: start-first' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: rollback_config: parallelism: 1 order: stop-first' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: placement: constraints: - node.role == manager - node.labels.region == us-east' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: placement: preferences: - spread: node.labels.zone' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: placement: max_replicas_per_node: 2' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: blkio_config: weight: 300 device_read_bps: - path: /dev/sda rate: 10mb' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: deploy: resources: limits: cpus: "0-3,5"' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: web: isolation: hyperv' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: ml: image: nvidia/cuda:12.4-runtime runtime: nvidia' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: app: runtime: runc' >> docker-compose.yml
echo 'services: app: privileged: true' >> docker-compose.yml
